scope: Bounded authenticated API, PostgreSQL contention, rollback, fail-closed, pool and cleanup verification only.

superseded_evidence.head: 7f739ae62f131c71720ca2889e692033a72796c3
superseded_evidence.reason: Three review findings required code changes after the successful run.

critic_findings.finding: Malformed and BOLA scenarios did not prove exact preauthorization rate-limit ordering.
critic_findings.repair: Added a thread-safe sanitized recording limiter and scenario-level exact scope/policy call assertions.

critic_findings.finding: ThreadPoolExecutor shutdown could wait beyond the advertised scenario timeout.
critic_findings.repair: Made the authoritative harness process-isolated per scenario with terminate/kill supervision and idempotent role cleanup.

critic_findings.finding: A schema-valid receipt could claim PASS with missing or internally failed scenario evidence.
critic_findings.repair: Added internal accounting/decision validators and cross-catalog completeness/configuration validation in write and verify paths.
